issues.title: Missing Leaf File Context
issues.why: The spec references 13 leaf files (01-13) for specific component logic (e.g., button variants, sidebar tree) that are not provided in the context.
issues.fix: Provide the content of files 01-13 or merge their core logic into the overview/AC files.

issues.title: Missing Concurrency/Race Condition for Theme Toggle
issues.why: While FOUC is addressed, the spec doesn't explicitly handle rapid-fire toggle clicks or storage event synchronization across multiple tabs.
issues.fix: Add a requirement for a 'storage' event listener to sync theme state across browser tabs.

issues.title: Incomplete Language-to-Color Map
issues.why: AC-018 lists 'typical mappings' but uses 'e.g.', leaving the full set of supported languages and their exact HSL values ambiguous for a coder.
issues.fix: Provide a complete, non-exemplary JSON mapping of language strings to HSL triplets.
